subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should Workspaces formally expose state:persist as a supported custom-widget capability and gateway contract?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it adds a durable widget API and expands the approved sandbox capability set; repository history shows the Workspaces foundation is accepted, not that this follow-on persistence contract has explicit maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Accept the capability direction after the contributor corrects the issue reference and demonstrates the current-head persistence and conflict flows in a real browser setup.

options.title: Defer stateful widgets
options.body: Keep Workspaces custom widgets read-only for now and close or pause this PR until the stateful-widget product direction is scheduled.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a smaller or internal-only persistence seam before committing to the public manifest and gateway capability names.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the capability direction after the contributor corrects the issue reference and demonstrates the current-head persistence and conflict flows in a real browser setup.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the current Workspaces product and owns the most relevant accepted implementation history for this API decision.
